text:
sam: Heads-up — hitting duplicate resource creates in prod after a transient 5xx + token refresh. Looks like idempotency header is being regenerated on retry. Repro steps below.

sam: Repro: async client -> POST /widgets -> 401 (token expired) -> auth middleware refreshes token -> retry kicks in -> server sees different X-Idempotency-Key -> creates a second resource. Seen ~3x in last 24h.

sam: logs: 
```
2026-03-18T18:03:12Z INFO http: request POST /widgets -> 401
2026-03-18T18:03:12Z INFO auth: refresh token complete
2026-03-18T18:03:12Z INFO retry: re-sending request
2026-03-18T18:03:12Z INFO http: request POST /widgets -> 201
```

sam: snippet:
```
# user code
resp = await client.post("/widgets", json=payload)
# our auth middleware does an in-place token refresh
# our retry path re-generates headers (including auto idempotency key)
```

elaine: Ugh. I think our SDK auto-sets X-Idempotency-Key if user doesn't provide one. The retry flow currently re-runs header factories which can regenerate that key. Shouldn't retries preserve the original idempotency header. :eyes:

mike: I ran into something similar w/ sync client + OAuth refresh. Our RetryPolicy calls `build_request()` again which invokes header factory. So we generate a new idempotency key every attempt. For non-idempotent ops that our server uses idempotency-key to dedupe, that's bad.

ana (typo fixed) ana: Two related points: 1) auth refresh should not mutate the original Request object used for the first attempt (pin old headers somewhere). 2) typing confusion: AsyncClient.request return types make it awkward to annotate streaming vs non-streaming paths. That's led to a few subtle uses where people call the wrong helper.

sam: Proposal: store a copy of original headers in RetryState at first attempt and reuse that copy for retries unless user explicitly allows regeneration. Add `pin_headers_on_retry: bool` to RetryOptions default true. Also ensure idempotency header is preserved.

mike: Patch sketch: change retry.prepare_for_retry(req) to accept original_headers and merge auth only, e.g.
```
def prepare_for_retry(req, original_headers):
    # preserve idempotency keys from original_headers
    for k, v in original_headers.items():
        if k.lower().startswith("x-idempotency"):
            req.headers[k] = v
    # refresh auth separately
    req.headers["Authorization"] = auth.refresh()
```

elaine: Also we should add tests: tests/test_retry_idempotency.py param both sync/async, simulate 401 followed by 503 then 201 and assert server saw just one create (same idempotency key). Add unit for header factory not being re-run.

ana ana: On the typing side: consider splitting signatures: `request()` -> always returns Response; `stream()` -> returns AsyncIterator[bytes]/Iterator[bytes]. Current overloads are too permissive and confuse mypy folks. Or provide `TypedResponse[T]` generics for body.

sam: Good call. Sync folks have the same problem. We should mention in changelog that the fix might be breaking for call sites that relied on header-factory side-effects during retries. But I think correctness > hidden side-effects.

mike: Another ops detail: our backoff is plain exponential (2**n * base). For 5xx storms that caused retries + simultaneous refreshes, we should switch to decorrelated jitter (aka "sleep = min(max, random_between(base, jitter*sleep_prev))"). Propose default to decorrelated jitter.

sam: Will open GH issue + PR. @ci-bot can you create issue + run unit tests?

ci-bot: Created issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/issues/3124 and queued tests.

mike: Quick TODOs: 1) small patch to preserve idempotency header in RetryState 2) pin auth refresh to request context (don't mutate original) 3) add tests for sync+async 4) add config option pin_headers_on_retry (default true) 5) switch default backoff to decorrelated jitter 6) typing doc change and new overloads for stream vs non-stream.

elaine: I'll own the tests + typing stubs. mike take the retry state changes. sam please open the PR and mark it semver-minor, call out behavioral change in release notes.

sam: Opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/pull/4567 — includes tests + opt-in flag. CI queued. Will follow up if any failures.

mike: LGTM, thanks. :thumbsup:

ana ana: small nits on PR: please add a comment explaining why we copy idempotency headers (link to issue). Also add a quick snippet in docs/advanced/retries.md showing how to provide your own idempotency header if you want regeneration.

sam: Will do. Thanks all.
